output.scope_note: This is a review of Li-ion conducting composite polymer electrolytes and garnet fillers, but it reports only two specific conductivity values for named materials, both cited from earlier work; the other numbers are generic ranges for whole material classes.

records.evidence_quote: For example, Matsumi et al. obtained ionic conductivity in organoboron polymer electrolytes of 3.05x10−5×S/cm.
